name: assistente-de-triagem-medica
description: API REST para assistente de triagem médica com persistência em memória.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api:cypress
scripts.test:cypress:all: start-server-and-test start:test-stack http://localhost:3000/api/health "cypress run --config baseUrl=http://localhost:4000 --env apiUrl=http://localhost:3000/api"
scripts.test:cypress:all:headed: start-server-and-test start:test-stack http://localhost:3000/api/health "cypress run --headed --config baseUrl=http://localhost:4000 --env apiUrl=http://localhost:3000/api"
scripts.test:api:cypress: start-server-and-test start:test-stack http://localhost:3000/api/health "cypress run --config baseUrl=http://localhost:4000 --env apiUrl=http://localhost:3000/api --spec 'tests/cypress/e2e/api/**/*.cy.js'"
scripts.test:api:cypress:headed: start-server-and-test start:test-stack http://localhost:3000/api/health "cypress run --headed --config baseUrl=http://localhost:4000 --env apiUrl=http://localhost:3000/api --spec 'tests/cypress/e2e/api/**/*.cy.js'"
scripts.test:cypress:open: start-server-and-test start:test-stack http://localhost:3000/api/health "cypress open --config baseUrl=http://localhost:4000 --env apiUrl=http://localhost:3000/api"
